recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, vertically-oriented rectangular portrait of a person in a straw hat, framed by a thick, solid olive-green border. The typography is layered over the top edge of the frame, featuring a dynamic, slanted script and a secondary sans-serif line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed within a high-contrast border
Text overlapping both the border and the image area
Warm skin tones and straw textures against a cool, dark green field
Diagonal script movement contrasting with the static rectangular frame
coreInvariants: Thin white internal keyline around the central image
Straw Panama hat with a dark band

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait centered within the inner frame, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The straw hat provides a bright, textured focal point at the top of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large script at the top left, follow the slant down to the subject's face, and then rest on the centered white tank top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial solid green border creates a 'window' effect, focusing all attention on the central portrait.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy tones in the border contrast with the high-key, warm saturation of the central photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Slanted, expressive script with connected characters
letterConstructionRules: Uniform line weight in the script
Sharp, pointed terminals on ascenders and descenders
Secondary text in all-caps, wide-tracked sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters are oversized and integrated into the flow of the lowercase letters
The 'S' and 'E' have elongated horizontal strokes

composition.position: below main title, crossing the frame line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script paired with a rigid, geometric sans-serif for structural balance.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule line extending from subtitle

preserve: Overlap of text across the frame boundary

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s expressive energy and slant.
Matches the geometric, clean look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium close-up portrait of a person wearing a straw Panama hat with a black band and a white tank top, smiling slightly and looking right. The background is a soft-focus outdoor park setting. Frame this image with a thin white line, then place it inside a large, solid olive-green square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, slanted pink script title in the top left corner, ensuring it overlaps both the green border and the top of the photo. Below it, add a single line of purple, wide-spaced uppercase sans-serif text that sits exactly on the top edge of the photo frame.

verificationChecks: Does the script overlap the image border?
Is the outer border a solid, flat olive green?
Is the subject wearing a straw hat?
Is there a thin white line separating the photo from the green border?

adjustableVariables: Color of the script (pink vs gold)
Density of the straw weave on the hat
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
The promotional stamp in the top right corner
Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the frame
High-quality film grain texture in the photo
avoid: Busy or cluttered backgrounds within the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script is slanted and monolinear.
Verify the olive green is a flat, matte color.
Check that the subtitle text is widely tracked.
Confirm the portrait is centered within the green field.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a soft-focus portrait, frame it with a thin white line inside a thick earthy-toned border, and overlay a dynamic, slanted script title that breaks the frame's boundary.
